note: 推流服务预设（04 Q31 (a)）：只是填地址的快捷方式，节目里只存完整地址，不存服务 id；App 按地址开头认出是哪个服务。顺序就是下拉的顺序。kind: custom = 自定义（不填地址）；perSession = 平台每场发地址 + 推流码（不填地址，只给一句去哪拿）；fixed = 入口固定，选中即填 url（可改）。入口地址的核对记录见 reports/w5-app-output-pages.md。

hint.zh-Hans: 地址写 rtmp://服务器/应用 或 rtmps://服务器/应用，推流码填在「密钥」里。自建服务器（MediaMTX、SRS、nginx-rtmp）要账号密码的，按它的规矩写在地址后面的查询串里，例如 MediaMTX 是 ?user=…&pass=…。
hint.en: Use rtmp://server/app or rtmps://server/app and put the stream key in Key. Self-hosted servers (MediaMTX, SRS, nginx-rtmp) that need a login take it in the query string after the address, e.g. ?user=…&pass=… for MediaMTX.

hint.zh-Hans: 地址写 srt://主机:端口?streamid=…&passphrase=…&latency=…（latency 单位毫秒，常用 120–2000）。streamid 和 passphrase 只用字母、数字和 - . _ ~，passphrase 10–79 个字符。密钥框填了会当作 streamid（地址里已有 streamid 时不用）。
hint.en: Use srt://host:port?streamid=…&passphrase=…&latency=… (latency in milliseconds, typically 120–2000). Use only letters, digits and - . _ ~ in streamid and passphrase; the passphrase must be 10–79 characters. A key in Key is sent as streamid unless the address already has one.

hint.zh-Hans: 在视频号助手网页（channels.weixin.qq.com）的直播管理里创建直播，复制「推流地址」填到地址、「推流密钥」填到密钥；每场直播都不一样。
hint.en: Create a live event under Live management in the Channels assistant web page (channels.weixin.qq.com), then copy the push address into Address and the push key into Key. Both change for every event.

hint.zh-Hans: 开播前在抖音的直播后台取「推流地址」和「推流码」，分别填到地址和密钥。地址和推流码每场可能不同；第三方推流可能要先在平台开通权限。
hint.en: Before going live, copy the push address and push code from Douyin's live console into Address and Key. They may change for every event, and third-party streaming may have to be enabled for your account first.

hint.zh-Hans: 在直播中心 › 我的直播间 › 开播设置里开播后，复制「服务器地址」填到地址、「串流密钥」填到密钥；密钥每次开播都会变。
hint.en: Start the live room under Live center › My live room › Settings, then copy the server address into Address and the stream key into Key. The key changes every time you go live.

hint.zh-Hans: 开播前在快手的直播后台取「推流地址」和「推流码」，分别填到地址和密钥。地址和推流码每场可能不同；第三方推流可能要先在平台开通权限。
hint.en: Before going live, copy the push address and push code from Kuaishou's live console into Address and Key. They may change for every event, and third-party streaming may have to be enabled for your account first.

hint.zh-Hans: 推流码在 YouTube 工作室 › 直播 › 串流设置里（「串流密钥」）。要加密传输可把地址改成 rtmps://a.rtmps.youtube.com/live2；备用入口 rtmp://b.rtmp.youtube.com/live2?backup=1 可以另加一个目的地，用同一个推流码。
hint.en: The stream key is in YouTube Studio › Go live › Stream settings. For an encrypted connection change the address to rtmps://a.rtmps.youtube.com/live2. The backup ingest rtmp://b.rtmp.youtube.com/live2?backup=1 can be added as a second destination with the same key.

hint.zh-Hans: Facebook 只收 RTMPS。在直播制作工具（Live Producer）里选「串流软件」，复制「串流密钥」填到密钥；页面上显示的服务器地址和这里不同时以页面为准。
hint.en: Facebook only accepts RTMPS. In Live Producer choose Streaming software and copy the stream key into Key. If the page shows a different server URL, use that one.

hint.zh-Hans: 这是 Twitch 的全球自动入口（就近分配）。推流码在创作者仪表板 › 设置 › 直播里（「主要串流密钥」）。
hint.en: This is Twitch's global ingest (routes to the nearest server). The stream key is in Creator Dashboard › Settings › Stream (Primary stream key).
